Our home planet is a story told in layers of science from the core at its center, through all the layers inside the planet, to the atmosphere and what happens in the layers above the surface of the Earth. Join Dr. Dan Polsgrove, Astronomer, Planetarium educator and former Astronomy professor here at the Academy, for a detailed discussion about our home planet. In addition to the Live portion of the show, the inner planets portion of two of our films, Worlds Beyond Earth and Oasis in Space will be included. Join Dr. Dan Polsgrove, Astronomer, Planetarium educator and former Astronomy professor here at the Academy, for a detailed discussion about the Earth – Moon – Sun relationship. which is the basis for our understanding of a great many space science concepts and physical laws of our universe. Some of the topics covered will be Orbits, Moon & Sun, solar system formation, eclipses and how they happen, tides and what causes them, as well as equinoxes/solstices, what are they and when do they happen. events.title: Holly & Ivy Concert – Dec. 4
events.head: Holly & Ivy Concert – Dec. 4 Friday, December 4 @ 7:00 pm - 10:00 pm « Bluebards Theatre Troupe: Come From Away Holly & Ivy Concert – Dec. 5 » Mark your calendar and save the date for this free event! The U.S. Air Force Academy Band will present its annual Holly & Ivy holiday concert series at the Arnold Hall Theater on Dec. 4-6. This year’s concert will capture the diverse holiday music traditions from across the nation. From classic “sing-along” favorites to exciting arrangements, the show will appeal to all ages. For more than 65 years, the band has used the power of music to honor our nation’s heroes, inspire Air Force personnel and the nation they serve, produce innovative musical programs and products, and communicate Air Force excellence to millions around the world. Doors will open one hour before showtime. We recommend arriving early for the best seating options. Ticket information and base access details to follow.
